## Question

What does this experiment test, and what outcomes would be informative?

## Protocol

- Condition, seeds, and run names:
- Project/upstream commits and checkpoint hash:
- Config/protocol version and manifest hash:
- Attack and evaluation definitions:
- Planned runtime/cost and remaining budget:

## Acceptance criteria

List the correctness checks and evidence needed to interpret this run.

## Results

Leave unfilled until measured. Link logs, curated metrics, failures, and
negative findings. Record actual cost and any deviations from the plan.
